label: Text 1
transcript: Mia's class is in London on a school trip. The double-decker buses are bright red. Big Ben is louder than expected. The pigeons in Trafalgar Square are bigger than the pigeons at home. Theo wants to ride on the top of every bus. Mr. Flint says: "We have a list. We follow the list."
